name: Dragon oF Dojima
description_html:
What’s this? The Dragon of Dojima and Mad dog of Shimano visit the norvinsk region. What mischief is this 2 up to? Let’s Find out!

Featuring the hit character from the hit crime drama game Yakuza (also known as Ryu ga gotoku) Kiryu Kazuma And Goro Majima.

The 4th Chairman of the Tojo clan visits Norvinsk region alongside his best pal!

This mod includes:
Custom head for both character (Available for both side) [there’s a bit of funky with choosing head. basically if you choose the head bear/usec, go back to side select and choose the opposite side. One of the head won’t load, so choose one side and head carefully. unless you know how to edit profile then you can just refer to the 2nd question}
Custom body and pants (Both are named Dragon of Dojima and Mad dog of Shimano respectfully)
Deadpan Face
Custom First person hand (wow so cool)

PS. Temporary look, i’ll get around and adjust his goofy ahh top and head

Pretty much all of the above

Note: Both of these clothing are available at Ragman for around 500~750$

Now for the totally not made up Question
Q. Is the outfit compatible with other clothing?
A. Depends. Majima pants are compatible with other upper, Kiryu Suit is fine with other pants and head, majima body will have weird clipping for different head and pants (if you decided to use other heads except majima, there will be weirdness) and Kiryu pants will also clip if you use non thick clothing (eg. clothing thatt’s like jacket n stuff).
Q. What’s the head Id?
A. Kiryu_Head and Majima_Head.
Q. Majima weapon?
A. Who knows.
Q. Why even make this mod?
A. Why not.

DISCLAIMER:
KIRYU AND MAJIMA NEVER KILLED ANYONE. EVEN IF THE GAME SAYS IT, IT’S NOT CANNON. THE ONLY DEATH THAT CAN HAPPEN IN A YAKUZA GAME IS FROM CUTSCENE.

PS. I heard custom clothing had some issue with latest client that being, only 1 custom clothing icon preview are rendered. This is purely Client side and idk how to fix this.
